info.name: TAPP Cash — All APIs
info.description:
Generated from OpenAPI specs in tapp-third-party-api-doc/reference/.

Set the collection variables (or use a Postman Environment) before making requests:
  • tenant       — your org subdomain
  • clientId / clientSecret — for Org API (server-to-server)
  • accessToken / refreshToken — filled automatically after Sign In
  • sessionId    — filled automatically after Create Session
  • deviceId     — any stable UUID for the client device

request.description:
Authenticates any user type and returns an access token and refresh token. Pass the role that matches the user type in the `roles` array.

Returns an `accessToken` (~10 min default) and a `refreshToken` (~35 min default).

**Role → User type mapping:**
- `root`, `superadvisor`, `branchmanager`, `advisor` → Administration users
- `individual` → Individual customers
- `businessowner` → Business owners
- `businessoperator` → Business operators

**Login methods:** email address, phone number (E.164), or username.

header.description: The refresh token returned at sign-in

request.description:
Exchange a valid refresh token for a brand-new access token and refresh token pair. Pass both tokens as HTTP headers — no request body.

**Important — single-use tokens:** Calling this endpoint immediately invalidates both the old access token and the old refresh token. You must save and use the new pair returned in the response. Re-using the old tokens after a successful refresh will return `401`.
Returns the full profile for the authenticated user. Works for all user types — the response structure varies by role but always includes `id`, `email`, `roleName`, `firstName`, and `lastName`.

Revokes the current access token, signing the user out. The token is retrieved from the `Authorization` header and immediately invalidated. After successful logout the token cannot be used for authentication.

Updates the authenticated user's password. Requires the current password for verification and a new password that meets complexity requirements.

**Password requirements:**
- 8–64 characters
- At least one uppercase letter, one lowercase letter, one number, and
  one special character


After a successful change a notification is sent to the user.

Authenticates your organization using `clientId` and `clientSecret`. Returns a `sessionId` valid for **24 hours**.

Optionally pass `customerUid` to scope the session to a specific user (sets `deviceSessionType` to `User`). Omit it for system-level operations (`deviceSessionType: System`).

**The `clientSecret` is never sent again after this call.** Store the returned `sessionId` and pass it on every subsequent request via the `X-Session-Id` header alongside `X-Client-Id`.

header.description: Session ID returned from the login endpoint.
The ClientId (`ci_test_…` or `ci_live_…`) used to create the session. The gateway verifies that the session belongs to this credential.

request.description:
Verifies that your current session is still active and returns the identity context it carries.

Use this endpoint to:
- **Confirm a session is valid** before making business API calls.
- **Inspect scope** — see whether the session is a `System` session or
  is scoped to a specific `customerUid`.

- **Diagnose auth failures** — if subsequent API calls return `401`,
  call this endpoint first to rule out an expired or revoked session.


Returns `200` with session details when the session is active. Returns `401` if the session is missing, expired, or the `X-Client-Id` does not match the session's credential.

This endpoint validates itself internally — no gateway fwdauth is required to call it.

Immediately invalidates the session. Use this when your backend is done acting on a user's behalf or when a user explicitly logs out of your integration.

The `X-Session-Id` header must match the `{id}` path parameter — you can only revoke a session you currently hold.

Returns the full profile of the user associated with the current session.

For **User sessions** (created with a `customerUid`), this returns the profile of that specific customer.

For **System sessions** (no `customerUid`), this returns the profile of the organization's root system user.

Use this endpoint to:
- **Fetch customer details** such as name, email, phone, date of birth,
  and physical addresses after creating a user-scoped session.

- **Confirm session identity** — verify which user the current session
  is acting on behalf of before performing sensitive operations.

item.name: Invitation
item.description:
**Steps 1 & 2 — Before you start.**
Validate the invitation link and fetch the agreements the user must accept. No authentication required.

query.description: The invitation token from the invitation email/SMS.

request.description:
Validates an invitation token and returns the associated role and phone number.

Call this endpoint first to confirm the token is valid before showing the user a
password-creation screen. If the token is invalid or already used, a `400` is returned.

**Possible error codes:**

| Code | Status | Description |
|------|--------|-------------|
| `INVITATION_DOES_NOT_EXIST` | 400 | Token not found or already used |
| `REQUIRED_INVITATION_TOKEN` | 400 | `token` query parameter is missing |

query.description: Agreement type. Use `Person` for individual users.

request.description:
Returns the list of agreements the user must review and accept before completing onboarding.
These are fetched from the Reseda document service.

Pass `type=Person` for individual users or `type=Business` for business onboarding.

**Possible error codes:**

| Code | Status | Description |
|------|--------|-------------|
| `INVALID_TYPE` | 400 | `type` must be `Person` or `Business` |

item.name: Onboarding
item.description:
**Steps 3, 4 & 9 — Account creation.**
Accept the invitation (returns a temporary token), review W9 terms, and submit KYC information to complete sign-up.

header.description: Session ID obtained by creating a session scoped to the invited user's `customerUid`.
Unique identifier for the client device. Use a UUID.

query.description: Invitation token (same value from step 1).

request.description:
Activates the invited user's account. No request body is required — the password is managed internally.

**Before calling this endpoint**, create a session scoped to the invited user using the `customerUid` returned in step 1, then pass the session headers (`X-Session-Id` + `X-Client-Id`) with this request.

On success (`200`), the account is activated with no further steps required.

On `403`, the account is created but **additional actions are required** (e.g., phone verification, KYC). Continue the onboarding flow using your session headers (`X-Session-Id` + `X-Client-Id`) for all subsequent `/limited/` endpoints.

**`403` meta.fields values:**

| Value | Meaning |
|-------|---------|
| `phoneNumber` | User must verify their phone number |
| `kyc` | User must complete KYC (individual signup) |
| `kyb` | User must complete KYB (business onboarding) |

**Possible error codes:**

| Code | Status | Description |
|------|--------|-------------|
| `INVITATION_DOES_NOT_EXIST` | 400 | Token is invalid or already used |
| `REQUIRED_DEVICE_ID` | 400 | `V-Client-Device-Id` header is missing |
| `REQUIRED_INVITATION_TOKEN` | 400 | `token` query parameter is missing |

Returns the W9 certification text that must be displayed to the user before they
submit their tax information during individual signup.

The response contains three distinct text blocks:

- **ExplanatoryText** — introductory explanation shown above the form
- **CertificationText** — legal certification text; display either
  `IsSubjectToBackupWithholding` or `IsNotSubjectToBackupWithholding` based on the
  user's selection
- **DisclosureText** — footer disclosure shown below the certification

**Authentication:** Requires the temporary access token from step 3.

**Possible error codes:**

| Code | Status | Description |
|------|--------|-------------|
| `UNAUTHORIZED` | 401 | Missing or invalid token |
| `INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR` | 500 | Unexpected server error |

Submits the individual's personal, employment, and financial activity information to
complete KYC verification. This is the most data-intensive step of the onboarding flow.

On success, the individual profile is created with a **pending** KYC status. The KYC
verification result is processed asynchronously by the BaaS provider.

**Authentication:** Requires the temporary access token from step 3.

**Required fields summary:**

| Section | Required Fields |
|---------|----------------|
| Personal | `dateOfBirth`, `socialSecurityNumber`, `usCitizenshipStatus`, `address` |
| W9 | `w9.isSubjectToBackupWithholding`, `w9.accepted`, `w9.timestamp` |
| Employment | `employment.isCurrentlyEmployed`, `employment.annualIncome` |
| Transfer Activity | At minimum the `*Expected` boolean flags for each transfer type |

**Possible error codes:**

| Code | Status | Field | Description |
|------|--------|-------|-------------|
| `DAY_BEFORE_NOW_INVALID` | 400 | `dateOfBirth` | Date must be in the past |
| `SSN` | 400 | `socialSecurityNumber` | Must match `XXX-XX-XXXX` |
| `CITY_HAS_INVALID_FORMAT` | 400 | `address.city` | City contains invalid characters |
| `DECIMALFORMAT` | 400 | `employment.annualIncome` | Must be a decimal string, e.g. `"65000.00"` |
| `BAAS_ERROR_FIELD` | 400 | — | External KYC service rejected the submission |
| `ALREADY_SIGNED_UP` | 400 | — | Individual has already completed this step |
| `UNAUTHORIZED` | 401 | — | Missing or invalid token |
| `INAPPROPRIATE_RIGHT` | 403 | — | User role is not allowed to call this endpoint |

item.name: Security Questions
item.description:
**Steps 5 & 6 — Identity verification setup.**
List the available security questions and submit the user's three answers. Requires the temporary token.

request.description:
Returns all active security questions ordered by `displayOrder`. Present these to the
user so they can pick three questions and provide answers.

This step happens after password creation (step 3) and before phone verification (step 7).

**Authentication:** Requires the temporary access token from step 3.

**Possible error codes:**

| Code | Status | Description |
|------|--------|-------------|
| `UNAUTHORIZED` | 401 | Missing or invalid token |
| `CANNOT_LOAD_SECURITY_QUESTIONS` | 500 | Failed to load questions |

Submits exactly **three** (questionId, answer) pairs for the authenticated user.
This call replaces any previously stored answers atomically.

After this call succeeds (`204`), the user can proceed to phone verification (step 7).

**Validation rules:**
- Exactly 3 answers required (`INVALID_SECURITY_ANSWER_COUNT` if not)
- Each `questionId` must appear only once (`DUPLICATE_SECURITY_QUESTION` if repeated)
- Answers must not be blank (`SECURITY_ANSWER_EMPTY`)
- Answers must not exceed 200 characters (`SECURITY_ANSWER_TOO_LONG`)
- Each `questionId` must reference an active question (`INACTIVE_SECURITY_QUESTION`)

**Authentication:** Requires the temporary access token from step 3.

**Possible error codes:**

| Code | Status | Description |
|------|--------|-------------|
| `INVALID_SECURITY_ANSWER_COUNT` | 400 | Must submit exactly 3 answers |
| `DUPLICATE_SECURITY_QUESTION` | 400 | Same question ID used more than once |
| `SECURITY_ANSWER_EMPTY` | 400 | An answer field was blank |
| `SECURITY_ANSWER_TOO_LONG` | 400 | An answer exceeds 200 characters |
| `INACTIVE_SECURITY_QUESTION` | 400 | A question ID is unknown or inactive |
| `UNAUTHORIZED` | 401 | Missing or invalid token |
| `CANNOT_STORE_SECURITY_ANSWERS` | 500 | Failed to persist answers |

Returns whether the user has already completed the security questions step.

Use this to decide whether to skip this screen when resuming an interrupted onboarding
session. If `completed` is `true`, jump directly to step 7 (phone verification).

**Authentication:** Requires the temporary access token from step 3.

item.name: Phone Verification
item.description:
**Steps 7 & 8 — Phone number confirmation.**
Send a one-time code to the user's phone and verify it. Requires the temporary token.

request.description:
Generates a one-time passcode (OTP) and sends it via SMS to the user's registered
phone number. The user then enters this code in the next step.

**Rate limiting:** This endpoint can only be called once every **30 seconds** per user.
If called too soon, the API returns `429` with a `Retry-After` header and a
`remainingSeconds` field in the error meta.

**Authentication:** Requires the temporary access token from step 3.

**Possible error codes:**

| Code | Status | Description |
|------|--------|-------------|
| `CAN_NOT_GENERATE_PHONE_VERIFICATION_CODE` | 400 | OTP generation or SMS delivery failed |
| `UNAUTHORIZED` | 403 | Missing or invalid token |
| `PHONE_VERIFICATION_CODE_RATE_LIMITED` | 429 | Called within the 30-second window |

Validates the OTP the user received via SMS. On success, marks the user's phone as
confirmed and updates their KYC status.

After this call succeeds (`204`), proceed to individual signup (step 9).

**Authentication:** Requires the temporary access token from step 3.

**Possible error codes:**

| Code | Status | Description |
|------|--------|-------------|
| `INVALID_CONFIRMATION_CODE` | 400 | The OTP is wrong or expired |
| `UNAUTHORIZED` | 403 | Missing or invalid token |

Returns transaction sums chart data showing total transaction amounts for the current month.
The data is always grouped into 5 columns representing equal divisions of the current month.

**Key features**:
- Always shows data for the current month (from 1st to last day)
- Returns exactly 5 data points dividing the month into equal parts
- Future columns (after current date) will exist but contain zero values
- Transaction amounts are shown as absolute values (positive)

| ACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND        | 404    | One or more specified accounts not found           |

item.name: Send OTP for delete user profile

header.description: Must be a token string with `Bearer` eg. `Bearer refreshtoken123`

request.description:
Generate and send an OTP (One-Time Password) for profile deletion verification. This endpoint validates that the user is eligible for profile deletion and sends an OTP that will be required for the actual deletion process.

**List of possible error codes**:

| Code                                    | Status | Target                                                        | Description                                      |
|-----------------------------------------|--------|---------------------------------------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------|
| REQUIRED_WITH                           | 400    | accountID                                                     | This field is required if fee is required                           |
| VALID_ACCOUNT                           | 400    | accountID                                                     | Incorrect account for debiting fee                       |
| ERROR_ACCOUNT_CREATION_PROCESS          | 400    | common                                                        | Cannot delete profile, accounts are being created                       |
| OTP_RATE_LIMITED                        | 400    | common                                                        | OTP rate limited - too many requests                    |
| FORBIDDEN                               | 403    | common                                                        | User is not allowed to delete profile                       |

**Deletion blockers (422 status)**:
In case something prevents deletion of user (e.g. having balance in accounts or pending transactions) returns 422 response with array of blockers:

* *[422]* **POSITIVE_BALANCE** - User has positive balance in accounts
* *[422]* **PENDING_TRANSACTIONS** - User has pending transactions  
* *[422]* **INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS_FOR_FEE** - Insufficient funds to pay closure fee

Permanently deletes the authenticated user's profile and closes all associated accounts.
Requires the OTP sent by `POST /branches/private/v1/delete-profile-otp`.

This action is irreversible. Ensure the user has withdrawn all funds and has no pending
transactions before calling this endpoint.

request.description:
Submits the complete KYB (Know Your Business) package — business entity details, Business Owner personal information, Controlling Party, and optionally an Authorized Signer.

After submission the KYB review is processed asynchronously. The status moves from `pending` to `approved` or `rejected`. Poll `GET /kyc/private/v1/requests/last` after token exchange (step 10) to monitor the result.

**Required parties:**
- **businessOwner** — at least one beneficial owner with ≥25% ownership (must include `ownershipPercentage` and `w9`)
- **controllingParty** — person with authority over business operations (must include `businessTitle`)
- **authorizedSigner** — optional, person authorized to sign for transactions

**Required business fields:** `businessLegalName`, `employerIdentificationNumber`, `legalStructure`, `transferActivity`, `businessActivity`, `taxIdentificationNumberType`
